I answered Pree in a thread on their message in #central-team: the store is **Pine Crossing**.

The source is Pree's own post in #central-team on Jun 9, 2026. The morning receiver there said the appointment screen showed only the afternoon shift. A driver who arrived at 7:10 had his trailer number written on a sticky note. Hollis said he'd check the shift template and ask support to reproduce it with the store login.

I didn't find a separate site code or address for Pine Crossing in anything Pree can see. The account file folders came back empty, and the brain had only that one conversation. I told Pree that if the sheet needs a code, they'll have to get it from store ops. The brain was running keyword-only search, so other wording may not have shown up. Everything I used came from #central-team, which Pree is a member of.
